svg.title: The engineer names new defenses and dependencies
svg.desc: Place defenses and new dependencies as separate consequences of continued work. The engineer's line should resist both a pure-benefit and a pure-harm illustration. Keep the paper-fragment perimeter and four empty wall bays visible as invented staging, with no official chamber insignia.
